statement.zh: PEACS 2008 项目综述列出苏佩谷发掘点卡拉尔、丘帕西加罗、米拉亚、卢里瓦西、阿斯佩罗，以及华乌拉谷 Vichama——名录取向；Vichama 年代常落在晚于卡拉尔纪念性窗的早期成型阶段，细节须跟进专报。
statement.en: PEACS 2008 project synthesis lists Supe excavations at Caral, Chupacigarro, Miraya, Lurihuasi, Áspero, plus Huaura’s Vichama—inventory orientation; Vichama often dates to Early Formative after Caral’s monumental window and needs dedicated reports.
